title: Daily Planet
summary: The same world for everyone each day, with one scored try and a result to share.
text:
**DAILY PLANET** on the title screen is a new skirmish every day: the same world, rivals and starting alloys for everyone who plays it that day. Rivals play harder at weekends.

You get **one scored try** a day. A win scores more the faster it is; a loss scores for how long you held on; kills and mining add to it, and losses take away. Reloading or playing again is practice.

When you're done, **Share** copies a little timeline of your game (quiet, fighting, heavy losses) without giving the map away. A new planet comes at midnight UTC.
